name: Shirley Temple's Storybook
description:
Shirley Temple's Storybook is an American children's anthology series hosted and narrated by actress Shirley Temple. The series features adaptations of fairy tales like Mother Goose and other family-oriented stories performed by well-known actors, although one episode, an adaptation of The House of the Seven Gables, was meant for older youngsters.

Temple's three children made their acting debuts in the last episode of the first season, "Mother Goose".

videos.title: Beauty and the Beast
videos.overview: Based on the novel by Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont, a merchant must give up one of his three daughters, or he will lose his life. Beauty sacrifices herself and so the story continues.

videos.title: Rumpelstiltskin
videos.overview: The miller Hanz Franz has bragged to one and all that his daughter Elsa can spin straw into gold. The poor girl is spirited away by the Royal Tax Collector Lord Karsch and locked in a room in the palace of the King.

videos.title: The Nightingale
videos.overview: The oppressed Chinese peasants and woodsmen have only one consolation -- the beautiful song of a nightingale. But word of this unusual bird reaches the emperor, who promptly orders it brought from the woods to the palace.

videos.title: The Land of Green Ginger
videos.overview: Abu Ali, son of the Emperor of China, Aladdin, is unable to choose a bride. Help comes from the genie of the Magic Lamp.

videos.title: Rip Van Winkle
videos.overview: Rip Van Winkle wanders off to a mountain haunt in the Catskills. There he encounters a strange crew of dwarfs, whose powerful brew lulls him into a 20-year slumber.

videos.title: The Sleeping Beauty
videos.overview: Tale of the a young woman cast in a spell that sends her to sleep and the prince who revives her.

videos.title: The Little Lame Prince
videos.overview: Prince Dolor, heir to the throne of Grauthenia, has been imprisoned by wicked King Bertrand.

videos.title: The Magic Fishbone
videos.overview: Princess Alicia has trouble feeding all the children.

videos.title: The Wild Swans
videos.overview: A wicked queen turns her stepsons into swans and tries to kill her stepdaughter.

videos.title: Hiawatha
videos.overview: An adaptation of Longfellow's poem about two young lovers from rival Indian tribes.

videos.title: Rapunzel
videos.overview: Prince Peter falls in love with a beautiful voice.

videos.title: Ali Baba and the 40 Thieves
videos.overview: A humble woodcutter, Ali Baba and his son Abdullah accidentally learn the location and means of entrance to a fantastic cache of treasure, used by a band of thieves. Unable to keep the secret of the cave from his greedy brother Kasim," Ali Baba reveals the magic password.

videos.title: The Emperor's New Clothes
videos.overview: The conniving tailor convinces the vain monarch that his invisible raiment really exists.

videos.title: Mother Goose
videos.overview: Mother Goose travels to Wayfair and tries to save the town's annual fair, which has been canceled by young Polly Baker's father, the Mayor.

videos.title: The Land of Oz
videos.overview: Lord General Nikidik wants to take over Oz, so he goes to Mombi and asks her to transform the beloved Princess Ozma into a marble statue. Mombi instead changes her into a boy, Tip, to be her servant, with no memory of her former life.

videos.title: Kim
videos.overview: A classic tale of high adventure, written by Nobel Prize winning author Rudyard Kipling. Embark on a virtual journey to the exotic land of colonial India during a time when, for one dangerous moment, the entire fate of the British throne rested upon the shoulders of a young boy named Kim, who must go undercover as a spy to stop a war.

videos.title: Winnie-the-Pooh
videos.overview: A captivating musical adventure into some of the most cherished Pooh stories including - 'Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree,' 'Eeyore Loses a Tail,' 'Winnie the Pooh in the Rabbit Hole,' 'Tigger,' and 'A Birthday Party for Eeyore.'

videos.title: Madeline
videos.overview: In an old house in Paris that was covered with vines lived twelve little girls in two straight lines. The smallest one was Madeline. Here, Shirley presents her favorite stories from Ludwig Bemelmans' classic children's book, Madeline, which recounts the unforgettable adventures of an invincible nine-year old girl.

videos.title: Little Men
videos.overview: All goes well for a professor and his wife at their Plumfield School for Boys until a lad who's in the habit of running away from home arrives.

videos.title: The Prince and the Pauper
videos.overview: Penniless in 16th-century London, Tom Canty finds he has an exact double - the heir to the throne.

videos.title: The House of the Seven Gables
videos.overview: An adaptation of Nathaniel Hawthorne's supernatural, romantic tale of a New England family and their life in the House of the Seven Gables, a two-hundred-year-old dwelling haunted by the ghosts of past generations.

videos.title: Babes in Toyland
videos.overview: An enchanting musical treasure - and unforgettable Christmas treat - hosted by Shirley and her real-life children. Babes in Toyland recounts a young boy and girl's adventures after running away from their wicked uncle Barnaby played by legendary Jonathan Winters. After passing through dark forests and the spooky village of Meantown, they find themselves in a magical toyland.

videos.title: Pippi Longstocking
videos.overview: High-spirited little girl Pippi lives every child's ultimate fantasy... escape from parental supervision in a world without rules!

videos.title: The Terrible Clockman
videos.overview: Based on a story by Jules Verne, an evil alchemist moves to a small Swiss village and wishes to marry the local clockmaker's beautiful daughter. When his request is refused he casts a spell that alters time and turns a large man-shaped clock into a walking (and ticking) monster that terrorizes the village.

videos.title: Onawandah
videos.overview: Onawandah, a small Indian lad, makes his way into a Puritan settlement in search of shelter. A nervous guard shoots the youth, who is carried to the home of widow Emily Winters for medical attention. Emily and her son Daniel plan to nurse the boy to his health, but the other settlers are opposed to having a heathen among them.

videos.title: The Return of Long John Silver
The Little Mermaid
videos.overview: Enjoy Hans Christian Andersen's legendary tale of a beautiful mermaid who rescues a ship-wrecked prince only to fall hopelessly in love with him. In order for the couple to be together, the mermaid must let go of all that she holds dear, and leave her beloved sea kingdom forever.

videos.title: The Princess and the Goblins
videos.overview: The classic story of a young princess who lives in a castle on a wild and lonely mountain. One day she discovers a stairway leading to a labyrinth of unused passages with closed doors behind which lie dungeons, goblins and a world of mysteries. Based on the novel by British author George MacDonald.
